title: A Safehouse for the Drop
author: Orsen Sandoval
blurb: Lena Underhill, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
